variants.title: A · 포슬린 화이트
variants.caption: 흰색 평면 캡 · 둥근 사각 모서리 · 짧은 네이비 측벽
variants.design: Porcelain-white matte keycaps with small-radius rounded square corners, a clean uninterrupted flat top and a very short dark navy lower sidewall. Light solid ceramic-like finish without gloss glare. Familiar low-profile keyboard-key silhouette, large tapping area.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied B rhythm-game frame. Produce ONE complete portrait frame, not a collage.
User correction: the current button caps are TOO TALL, TOO CONCAVE, and too dark. Redesign ONLY the FOUR movable keycaps with a CLEARLY LOWER profile, COMPLETELY FLAT broad striking surfaces, and the requested new material color.
Remove ALL concavity, scoops, dishes, bowl shading, raised perimeter lips, inset top wells and tall flared skirts. The new flat top should cover most of each key footprint; its short front wall is just a narrow band, roughly a third or less of the old tall skirt. Keep a small physical key-travel gap so these remain tactile rhythm-game keys, not screens. Modest softly finished or chamfered edges as specified below; no sculpted depression or pillow-like top.
Keep the EXACT existing camera, perspective, portrait composition, four key positions and broad footprints. Preserve every fixed support housing and its ONE continuous wide aperture, the whole silver/navy/gold frame, tall cyan side gauges without ticks, lane field, lower bumper and background. The color changes apply ONLY to the keycaps.
Use the SAME demonstrated SINGLE state in every concept: keys 1, 3 and 4 are raised and show the new base material color without glowing; ONLY key 2 is slightly physically depressed and lights pale cyan on its flat top. Preserve the white-centered cyan flash facing the viewer in the single aperture below key 2. Other three apertures stay dark. Keep the active key and the compact flash legible; do not recolor the frame or change the note-state light colors.
No text, key legends, symbols, logos, circles, extra holes, bars across apertures, camera change, crop or extra panel.
Variant design: Porcelain-white matte keycaps with small-radius rounded square corners, a clean uninterrupted flat top and a very short dark navy lower sidewall. Light solid ceramic-like finish without gloss glare. Familiar low-profile keyboard-key silhouette, large tapping area.

Preserve the pale cyan key glow and white-centered flash in the single aperture beneath it. Keep keys 1, 3 and 4 and their material colors exactly as shown. Keep all fixed housings and single apertures, frame, gauges, background, composition and camera unchanged. One full portrait image, no text, no crop.
